verdict.rationale: Meilisearch has no documented dedicated sandbox or staging feature. However, it is a dependency-free single binary that installs locally via cURL, Docker, Homebrew or APT, and its official Docker images are positioned 'for easy deployment and development.' Users can therefore stand up an isolated test instance, which community users confirm is quick and easy, and a 14-day cloud trial offers a separate project. This is a self-managed workaround rather than a first-class sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment or test-mode feature, guidance on cloning or seeding production indexes into an isolated test instance, and any agent-oriented sandbox workflow (e.g. via MCP).
